def: The text a model reads on a single call, including system prompt, tool definitions, history, tool results and retrieved material; it is the model's only working memory.
Curating and maintaining the set of tokens a model sees at each step of an agent run, beyond writing a single prompt.
The decline in a model's ability to use information in its window as the amount of text grows, especially with distractors.
The idea that each added token draws down the finite attention a model can spend, so more context has diminishing and sometimes negative returns.
Keeping lightweight references such as paths and queries and loading the data with tools only when a step needs it, instead of loading it up front.
Letting an agent discover context step by step, with each retrieved piece guiding what to look at next, so the window holds only what was chosen.
Replacing old tool outputs in the history with short placeholders while keeping the calls and the model's own messages.
Summarising a conversation that is nearing its context limit and continuing in a fresh window that starts from the summary.
Having the agent write notes such as decisions, open bugs and next steps to storage outside the window and read them back later.
Giving a side task to a sub-agent with its own clean window so that only a short summary of the result enters the main context.
Provider-side reuse of the unchanged start of a request at a lower price, which is invalidated when anything earlier in the prompt changes.
Writing instructions specific enough to guide behaviour but flexible enough to give the model heuristics, avoiding both brittle if-then rules and vague guidance.
